message.content: The last common ancestor of a lion (Panthera leo) and a zebra (Equus quagga) is the most recent common ancestor of **all placental mammals** (Eutheria). This ancestor lived roughly 100 million years ago, before the diversification of the major placental lineages such as Carnivora (lion) and Perissodactyla (zebra).
